claim: Under identical raw-video perception and a preregistered five-percent negative-transfer budget, game-acquired symbolic structure improves final AGQA2 answer accuracy over the shared neural actor and a matched source-lineage permutation.
protocol_change_timing: Preregistered after qualification_v4 was consumed and before any runtime or outcome on this fully history-disjoint replication cohort.

consumed_qualification_v4.reason_for_replication: V4 established a safe source-vs-neural signal but used an all-fallback source-permuted control and an all-gates rule that did not distinguish safe from unsafe symbolic policies.

shared_pipeline.action_tool: frozen SlowFast-R50 Charades dense10x32 at threshold 0.1
shared_pipeline.atomic_claim_grounder: frozen Qwen3-VL-32B, 96 uniform full-video frames, one scoped operator-free proposition per call

arms.generic_scaffold: all shared VM primitives with eager execution and no intervention-derived abstention
arms.source_permuted: exact source operator inventory and exact edge count with a fixed one-step operator-label derangement applied to composition lineage; same root-aware guard
arms.source_induced: source-induced operators, authentic source composition lineage, and source-induced root-aware three-valued abstention
arms.target_written_isomorphic: exact source-induced policy clone used only as an action-equivalence ceiling

risk_constraint.definition: For each symbolic arm, losses are tasks neural-only gets correct and that arm gets wrong.
risk_constraint.best_feasible_rule: Source-induced accuracy must be at least that of every symbolic arm whose losses relative to neural-only are within the same five-percent budget.
risk_constraint.generic_interpretation: Generic remains an unrestricted non-crippled control. Higher raw accuracy does not satisfy the safe-transfer claim if its negative-transfer losses exceed the preregistered budget.

decision_rule: The replication passes only if every gate passes in one immutable outcome evaluation after all shared runtime artifacts and source/permuted coverage are frozen. Failure consumes this cohort and forbids same-cohort tuning.
